enemy-036-deacon-line.note: Twelve independent manual chords across four clips; three clearly visible upper-beak poses per clip. Median idle chord divided by each clip median gives sourceScaleByClip. These factors act once on original 1774x887 sources during normalization, never on an already scaled atlas. Within-clip skull drawing variation and +/-5px endpoint uncertainty remain; this is consistent project scale, not 1:1 anatomical certification.
